passage.label: O wraps himself clothing; arise pray night except little; half subtract little; add recite Quran measured recitation; indeed cast upon you heavy word; indeed hours night more effective concurrence heart tongue more suitable words; indeed day prolonged occupation; remember name Lord devote yourself complete devotion; Lord East West no deity except Him take Him Disposer affairs

arabicExcerpts.text: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـٔٗا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحٗا طَوِيلٗا
وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلٗا
رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا

mainSubject.label: The wrapped one commanded to arise for night prayer except a little — half the night or slightly less or more — reciting the Quran with measured recitation since a heavy word is about to be cast upon him; night hours identified as more effective for heart-tongue concurrence and more suitable for speech while daytime holds prolonged occupation; remembrance of the Lord's name and complete devotion urged toward the Lord of east and west who alone is deity and should be taken as disposer of affairs

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Lord-of-east-and-west tawheed and disposal command (9) before the patience-and-denier-punishment block opens (10); P2 ends with the reminder-and-way declaration (19) before the single-verse concession and reaffirmation (20); P3 is the comprehensive v20 covering night-prayer observation, divine easing, illness-travel-fighting exemptions, standing obligations and closing istighfar.
